# Module 6 — enum and unit testing

Allowed: modules 1–5, plus `enum` (constants, fields, constructors, methods, and `switch` on an enum) and JUnit tests with `@Test`, `@BeforeEach`, `@AfterEach`, `assertEquals`, `assertTrue`, `assertFalse`, and `assertNull`.

Do not suggest or require: inheritance, interfaces, abstract classes, nested classes, collections, regular expressions, exceptions, `try`, `catch`, `throw`, `assertThrows`, lambda expressions, `Optional`, the Date-Time API, the Stream API, threads, files, or web APIs.

Do not require parameterized tests, Mockito, or AssertJ. Review the enum and whether the tests check the behavior the task asks for.
